businessMeaning: Replace direct organization mutation screens with an as-of organization graph and effective-dated assignment-event workflow while emitting the canonical organization change signal.

provenExisting: The production OrganizationExplorer and organization chart, intelligence, scenario, position, move, validation, approval and publication services already implement the main organization engine.
As-of graph behavior, cycle and overlap guards, tenant scoping and impact preview already exist in the organization package.
BASE-TFR-HRM-008 already completed PEP-HRM-006 through PEP-HRM-009, its assignment-event UI, V55 and targeted evidence.
XCON-006 and its generated OrganizationChanged.v1 payload contract already exist, and Performance already consumes it.
missingWork: Add the canonical PEP-HRM-010 graph query adapter at GET /api/people/v1/hris/organizations/graph backed by the existing organization engine.
Expose the canonical organization-positions workspace by adapting the existing OrganizationExplorer rather than creating a second graph or scenario engine.
Append OrganizationChanged.v1/XCON-006 transactionally from the existing successful scenario publication boundary with idempotent outbox semantics.
noTouchOrRecount: Do not reopen, clone or count BASE-TFR-HRM-008.
Do not create a second assignment-event workflow or a second organization graph persistence model.
Do not regenerate or modify XCON-006 unless an independently proven contract defect receives a separate Control packet.
Do not count existing scenario, position, cycle, overlap, tenant or impact-preview behavior as newly delivered HRM-005 work.

readOnlyReusePaths: backend:dwp-people-server/src/main/java/com/dwp/services/people/organization/** except the exact publication seam allocated above

experienceContract.primaryUser: HR business partner with organization-view duty
experienceContract.operationalQuestion: What is the effective organization and position structure at the selected date, and what changed through an approved scenario?
experienceContract.primaryAction: Inspect the graph and open an existing governed assignment or scenario workflow.
experienceContract.implementationRule: Reuse and adapt the existing OrganizationExplorer; preserve URL scope, as-of date, focus and inspector state.

domainRules: Published graph and positions are effective-dated and tenant-scoped.
Cycle, overlap and stale-revision failures have no partial side effects.
Only a successful enabled publication appends one deterministic organization-change event.
Correction is forward-only; emitted history and published snapshots are immutable.

migration.rule: Reuse the existing People outbox and organization schema. Control may lease V57 only after the owner proves an append-only schema requirement that cannot be represented by the current model.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: PEP-HRM-010 returns the existing as-of graph and positions in stable order without creating a parallel source of truth.
As-of changes preserve effective intervals and reject stale or overlapping mutations without partial writes.
Cycle validation and impact preview remain behaviorally identical to the existing organization engine.
Wrong tenant, legal entity, organization scope, purpose, field decision or policy revision fails closed and does not disclose node existence.
A successful enabled scenario publication appends exactly one OrganizationChanged.v1 envelope with XCON-006 payload and source revision.
Exact replay is idempotent, mismatched replay conflicts, and a failed publication emits no change event.
The canonical route adapts the existing OrganizationExplorer and preserves tab, as-of date, selected focus and return navigation.
Loading, empty, unavailable, partial, complete, permission-denied and stale states are materially distinct and never render a blank canvas.
Deep links and actions are allowlisted and hidden or disabled from the same server-authoritative access decision.
1440, 1280, 390, 320 and 200-percent zoom plus light, dark, high contrast, reduced motion and keyboard navigation pass.
Feature OFF or unenrolled tenant mounts no owner data runtime and sends no organization query or command.
Changed-path evidence proves HRM-008 employment, generated XCON, central authorization and historical registers were not modified or counted.

backendTargets: HRM-008 regression only if its shared outbox or publication seam changes
frontendTargets: one canonical-route responsive and accessibility journey after central Auth integration
databaseTargets: V57 clean and V56-to-V57 upgrade only when V57 is actually leased

required: backend and frontend module branch SHAs
twelve acceptance results with test or source evidence
migration non-need proof or active V57 lease plus clean-upgrade evidence
